title: Riyadh Season 2026-2027 (Big Time)
description: Riyadh Season's seventh edition, themed 'Big Time', opened October 21, 2026 with a 10-week headline programme of sport, concerts, cultural experiences and family entertainment across Riyadh (Boulevard City, Boulevard World, Winter Al Dirah, VIA Riyadh and other zones). Visit Saudi lists the wider season through March 1, 2027; some zones stay open longer than the main programme.

title: Boulevard World (Riyadh Season 2026-2027)
description: Boulevard World, Riyadh Season's international-pavilion entertainment zone, opened October 30, 2026 for the 2026-2027 season. In the prior season it stayed open for months after the main programme ended (11 Oct 2025 - 2 May 2026), so the end date above is intentionally left blank rather than guessed.

title: Winter Al Dirah (شتاء الديرة)
description: Winter Al Dirah is Riyadh Season's heritage area and traditional-markets zone in old Riyadh (near Qasr Al Hokm), running for the length of the 2026-2027 season alongside a farmers' market and the 'Ana Arabia' exhibition at VIA Riyadh.

title: GC Playoffs (Golf, Riyadh Season)
description: The GC Playoffs golf tournament is confirmed in Riyadh from November 18 to 21, 2026, as part of Riyadh Season's sporting calendar.

title: Rashed Al Majid Live in Riyadh
description: A Rashed Al Majid concert reported for Riyadh Season 2026 at Mohamed Abdo Arena by Emirates NBD. NOTE: the source article's own weekday/year pairing for this date was internally inconsistent -- verify the exact date against an official ticketing page before import.
location: Mohamed Abdo Arena by Emirates NBD, Riyadh

title: Fadel Chaker Live in Riyadh
description: A Fadel Chaker concert reported for Riyadh Season 2026 at the Abu Bakr Salem Stage, over two nights (October 22-23, 2026).
